title: Embeddings — How AI Finds Information
summary: Embedding finds meaning, not just literal words — Vector Search connects different phrases.

sections.heading: Orientation — Introduction to the Lesson
sections.subtitle: Introduction to the Lesson
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **What will you understand?** **Embedding (converting words to numbers that represent meaning)** **finds meaning** — **not just the literal word**.
- **Why now?** **RAG needs to search your files** — **and regular search doesn’t understand ‘what you mean’**.
- **What after the lesson?** **You will write two different questions in words** — **same meaning**.
- **Optional depth:** **For those who want to build a real RAG**. **You can skip it and come back later**.

sections.heading: Tension — The client wrote ‘How does AI respond?’ — and got no results
sections.subtitle: The client wrote ‘How does AI respond?’ — and got no results
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **Traditional search looks for words literally**. **‘Respond’ is not written in the article** — **even though the article explains the topic!**
- **The storage is good at comparing texts** — **but it doesn’t understand that ‘respond’, ‘answer’, and ‘generate a response’ mean the same thing**.
- **For RAG to work correctly**, **we need meaning-based search** — **not letter-based**.

sections.heading: Core idea — Embeddings find meaning — not words
sections.subtitle: Embeddings find meaning — not words
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **Embedding** = **converting any text into a list of numbers that represent ‘its place on the map of meanings’**.
- **Sentences close in meaning — their numbers are close**. **‘A cat playing’ and ‘A dog running’ are closer than ‘the stock market’**.
- **When the client asks**, **we convert their question into a Vector (a way to store meaning digitally)** **and search for the closest Chunks (small pieces of content)** — **even if the words are different**.

sections.heading: Glossary — Two terms to start
sections.subtitle: Two terms to start
sections.contentMarkdown:
| Term | Meaning | Example |
|------|---------|---------|
| **Embedding (converting words to numbers that represent meaning)** | **Converting text to a Vector** — **numbers describing meaning on a ‘map’** | **‘Arabic’ → 1536 numbers describing meaning from different angles** |
| **Vector Search (meaning-based search)** | **Searching for the closest Vectors to the question** — **not a literal match** | **‘Quick recipes’ finds ‘meals in 15 minutes’** — **without the word ‘quick’** |

**Recipe name + ingredients + preparation method — together**.
Recipe name only**.**

| Dimension | Weight | Criteria |
